title: Oasis of Nashville, With a pool and Hot Tub !
description:
Fully Furnished home on 3/4 of an acre .Centrally located to Nashville and the airport. Wonderful kitchen a chefs dream! Lots of dinning room or game playing at the large table in the kitchen or area of the living room. 
A fully fenced backyard with a private pool and Hot tub for you and your family to enjoy after fun day in downtown or stay home then see the city at night... Master bedroom king bed with en-suite bath , two other bedrooms queen beds with shared bath.

The space
Our home ! 
1 bedroom queen bed , 2 bedroom queen bed shared bath in the hall , master king bed with en-suite bathroom large soaking tub separate shower large vanity. 
Living area dining area for 4 , eat in kitchen for 4 , stocked kitchen, washer and dryer for your use in the garage, the large 3/4 acre yard with a pool.
Our home is located South of Nashville we are : 
10.6 to Broadway , Ryman 
12.3 airport 
11.4 Nissan stadium 
3.6 Nashville zoo 
7 miles to 12 south
8.7 Radnor lake 
15.4 Opry mills  and the Grand Ole Opry

Guest access
You’ll have this wonderful home to yourself during your stay !
Access is given on check in day texted to your cell number.

Other things to note
Strict NO parties in our house if you do make a bad choice..you will be fined the deposit and any additional cleaning expenses and be asked to leave. 
Be safe have fun when using the pool there is no lifeguard on duty !
If you’re bringing a pet you must clean up after them and be a responsible pet parent. If I have to clean up It doesn’t make me happy ..
